sections.text: You enter a magnificent castle where tales speak of a fearsome dragon guarding ancient treasure. The ground trembles with each step.

options.description: Head toward the tower where the dragon sleeps
Search the castle halls for clues

sections.text: You find an old journal describing the dragon's weakness: it fears fire magic.

options.description: Proceed to confront the dragon directly

sections.text: You reach the dragon's chamber. The mighty beast opens its eyes, smoke billowing from its nostrils!

consequence.text: The dragon's claws rake across your armor!

options.description: Try to negotiate with the dragon

sections.text: You discover an ancient fire spell scroll. Power surges through you!

options.description: Return to face the dragon with the spell

sections.text: The dragon's fire engulfs you both in a fierce battle!

consequence.text: Another blast of dragon fire hits you.

sections.text: To your surprise, the dragon pauses. It speaks in a ancient voice...

options.description: Listen to what the dragon says

sections.text: You channel the fire spell! The dragon roars as magical flames strike it down. Victory is yours!
After an epic battle, the dragon falls. You have defeated the monster!
You flee the castle with your life, but the dragon remains undefeated.
The dragon offers you a place in its hoard as guardian. A strange ending to your quest...
